relationships.subject: Heme
relationships.evidence_quote: Gene expression studies showed a significant increase in M1-associated markers, like iNOS, TNFα, and MHCII (Figure 2J–L)

key_findings: Heme activates TLR4 to polarize macrophages to M1, lowering beta-endorphin; TAK-242 reverses this in vitro and in PHZ hemolysis mice.
TLR4 blockade or hemopexin reduces heme-induced mechanical and heat hypersensitivity; cold allodynia appears TLR4-independent.
